title: Approve a memory entry
goal: Record human approval or rejection for exactly one memory registry entry. Boundary: approval and book are distinct ceremonies — approve authorizes; a later book registers the MEMORY.md surface and promotes to active.

entryId.description: Registry entry id to approve or reject (exactly one per call).

decision.description: Approval decision. reject requires a non-empty --reason (enforced by the handler).

reason.description: Rejection reason. Mandatory (handler-enforced non-empty) when decision is reject; recorded in the memory-approval event and the entry lastRejection.

submissionCriteria: entry exists in the memory registry
entry is in proposal state for the decision to be valid
